visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals are seated on a bright blue couch. On the left, a woman with a blonde ponytail wears an oversized white graphic tee and holds a yellow notebook. On the right, a man with glasses and a blue shirt looks at her while speaking. The setting is a clean, white-walled room. (2) A cut reveals the same pair on the couch, but the man now wears a black and green zip-up jacket. The woman holds a yellow smartphone instead of a notepad. Their facial expressions shift from calm conversation to more animated questioning and defensive posturing. (3) The camera shows the woman hitting the man lightly with the yellow notebook. He flinches. Later, both are seen looking down at their respective handheld devices, a yellow notebook and a smartphone, with varying levels of focus and frustration on their faces. (4) The scene shifts to a brightly lit classroom. A woman in a white blouse, portraying a teacher, sits at a desk with papers. The man, now in a white school uniform, stands in front of her. She slams papers onto the desk with an angry expression.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic sketch depicting a student who fails to complete a summer internship assignment because he stubbornly insists on only interviewing the celebrity Ariana Grande, leading to a breakdown when confronted by his teacher.
